Using rank(U+V)<=rank(U)+rank(V) and rank(A∘B)<=rank(A)rank(B), if A,B have rank<=R then the NAND sign matrix has rank<=(R+1)^2-1. Induction from R_0=1 gives rank<=2^{2^s}-1 after s gates. For IP_m, S is the Hadamard matrix of order 2^m, hence has rank 2^m. Thus 2^m<=2^{2^s}-1, so 2^s>m and s>=floor(log_2 m)+1.
